F2_skill_discovery.root_cause: Claude Code 2.x does not load skills from ~/.claude/skills/ when the skill directory is a symlink. The Phase 11 installer created ~/.claude/skills/rhino-chatgpt-orientation as a symlink to the project directory. ToolSearch and the Skill tool failed to resolve it across two sessions and a restart. Real file copies in ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md are loaded correctly.
F2_skill_discovery.discovery_mechanism: Skills under ~/.claude/skills/ require a real directory with a real SKILL.md file. Symlinks to directories are not followed by Claude Code's skill scanner. Skills under ~/.claude/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/skills/ also work but require plugin registration.
F2_skill_discovery.fix: Updated install-claude-orientation.sh to replace the symlink with a managed real directory copy. On first run it detects and removes the legacy symlink, creates ~/.claude/skills/rhino-chatgpt-orientation/ as a real directory, copies SKILL.md from the canonical project source, writes a .managed-by-install-claude-orientation marker, and verifies byte-for-byte identity.

installer_validation.first_run: migrated legacy symlink → created real copy, byte-match OK
installer_validation.second_run: idempotent, no changes except overwrites SKILL.md with fresh copy from canonical source
installer_validation.uninstall: removes managed directory (marker-protected), removes managed CLAUDE.md block
installer_validation.conflict_protection: stops if directory exists without marker file

fresh_session_skill_visibility.method: After running installer (second pass), rhino-chatgpt-orientation appeared in the current session's skill list without a restart. This confirms that ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (real file) is loaded in the running session when the installer runs — or at least is recognized without a fresh session.
fresh_session_skill_visibility.evidence: skill list system-reminder update showed 'rhino-chatgpt-orientation: Load the canonical Rhino CHATGPT orientation system...' immediately after installer completed

files_not_changed: server.py (protected — F1b fix deferred to controller amendment)
remaining_uncertainties: F1b (server.py broken import) must be fixed before rhino-cad tools are reachable. This is a 1-line change that requires controller authorization.
After F1b is fixed, Rhino must be running and rhinocode accessible for the MCP server to respond to tool calls. Rhino availability was not tested in this phase.

The skill copy approach means the personal skill can drift from the canonical source if the project SKILL.md is updated without re-running the installer. The installer's second-run behavior (overwrite with fresh copy) handles this, but it requires the user to run ./install-claude-orientation.sh after any skill content update.
